title: Transport and Journeys
subtitle: Summer 1 · 6-week overview
summary: Exploring vehicles and journeys through songs, stories, sounds and mark making, noticing real vehicles around us and building fine motor skills as we grasp, roll and move toy vehicles.
intentions: To share enjoyment with an adult during songs, stories or play about vehicles.
To listen to and begin to recognise transport sounds e.g. sirens, horns, etc.
To strengthen fine motor skills by grasping, rolling, and moving vehicles.
To notice real vehicles in the environment e.g. cars, bikes, buses, etc.
To explore mark making with toy vehicles in paint, sand, or gloop (tracks, patterns).
books: We’re Going On A Bear Hunt by Michael Wayne Rosen

events.label: St. a practitioner’s Day: Making paper plate dragons
International Nurses Day: Doctors pretend play

days.title: Toy cars in kinetic sand
days.what: Set up the messy tray with kinetic sand and add some cars. Encourage the children to explore, rolling the cars back and forth in the sand.

days.title: Parking cars on numbered spaces
days.what: Get some card and number parking spaces. Provide some cars and support the children to park the cars into the numbered spaces.

days.title: Painting with car wheels
days.what: Provide paint pots and cars. Encourage the children to dip the cars into paint and make marks with the wheels on card.

days.title: Washing cars
days.what: Set up the messy tray with soapy water, sponges and cars. Encourage the children to use the sponges to clean the cars and dry them using towels.

days.title: ‘We’re Going on a Bear Hunt’ by Michael Wayne Rosen
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Airplanes in shaving foam
days.what: Set up the messy tray with shaving foam and airplanes. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Rolling tyres
days.what: Using the tyres in the garden, stand them up and encourage the children to roll them.

days.title: Drawing with cars
days.what: Tape pens to cars and encourage the children to push the cars back and forth to make marks.

days.title: Trains small world
days.what: Provide the trains small world, encouraging the children to help set up the tracks and push the trains along.

days.title: Boats in water
days.what: Set up the messy tray with water, adding blue food colouring. Add some boats and allow the children to explore.

days.title: Car rolling ramps
days.what: Set up the ramps in the garden and provide the cars. Encourage the children to roll the cars down the ramps.

days.title: Sticking transport pictures
days.what: Collect magazines and cut out pictures of transport. Provide card and PVA and allow the children to stick the transport pictures.

days.title: Airport and airplanes
days.what: Provide the airport and airplanes small world toys from pre-school. Allow the children to explore and play.

days.title: ‘Things That Go’ by Campbell Books
days.what: Read at circle time, encouraging the children to copy the names of the transport.
